clips.label: The Sleeping Presence · 10 seconds
clips.note: Small lava curls accompany a gradual drifting approach and bank around the sleeping face.
clips.details: Starts from the selected B artwork. Four regional curls act around the lava, with a camera onset that ramps over approximately two seconds. Krea 2 Turbo, three Euler updates, noise 0.72, CFG 1; warped-previous-image feedback with the additional reference adapter off. The material prompt emphasizes fine ribs, scarlet inlays and sharp black-glass reflections. RIFE stays outside feedback. The generated face is glossier and more stylized than the original; some tiny architecture simplifies during repainting.
